title: Data Retrieval and Memory
summary: This module provides functionalities for efficient data retrieval and robust memory management, enabling AI applications to access relevant information and maintain conversational context.

nodes.label: Retrievers
nodes.title: Retrievers Module
nodes.description: Provides tools for efficient document retrieval, offering various strategies to fetch relevant information from diverse sources based on a given query.

nodes.label: Memory Management
nodes.title: Memory Management Module
nodes.description: Provides various memory implementations for storing and managing conversation history in AI applications, ranging from simple buffers to more advanced summarization and entity-aware memories.

nodes.label: Embeddings and Vectorstores
nodes.title: Embeddings and Vectorstores Module
nodes.description: Provides functionalities for generating text embeddings and storing them in vector databases, including tools for creating, managing, and querying vector stores, as well as caching embedding results.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: Language Model
nodes.description: An external component representing a Large Language Model, used for generating queries, extracting information, or filtering documents.

nodes.label: Documents
nodes.title: Documents
nodes.description: Structured pieces of information, often text, that are processed and stored for retrieval.

edges.label: can use vector stores for long-term storage

groups.label: Data Access Layer
groups.title: Data Access Layer
groups.description: Components responsible for fetching, indexing, and storing data, primarily through vector embeddings and retrieval mechanisms.

groups.label: Context Management
groups.title: Context Management
groups.description: Components dedicated to maintaining and managing conversational history and other stateful information for AI applications.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Dependencies
groups.description: Key external components that interact with the data retrieval and memory modules, such as language models and raw documents.
